- Agriculture Labour
- All Colleges
- All Farmers
- All Individuals
- All Students
- Anganwadi Worker
- College Students
- Farm Labourer
- Horticulturists
- Self-Employment
- Skilled Individual
- Small and Marginal Farmers
- Small, Marginal & Other Farmers

- Minimum: 10 days

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme "Training for Horticulture Skill Development for Self-Employment at Centre of Excellence " is aimed at promoting self-employment opportunities across all communities in Gujarat through practical and theoretical learning at the Centre of Excellence.

children.text: The scheme "Training for Horticulture Skill Development for Self-Employment at Centre of Excellence" introduced by the Agriculture, Farmers Welfare and Cooperation Department, Gujarat,  aims to offer structured training programs ranging from 10 to 30 days, focusing on horticultural skills to enable self-employment. The program is tailored for individuals across all social categories, with subsidized training costs. Beneficiaries gain access to a complete learning experience, including expert sessions, training literature, educational tours, and practical kits.
